ttl.name: Front Shock Absorber w/ Coil Spring

s-1.ptxt: Secure Front Shock Absorber Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Install the bolt and nut to the front shock absorber assembly LH as shown in the illustration, and secure it in a vise.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Coil Spring Insulator Lower LH

s2.ptxt: Install the front coil spring insulator lower LH.

atten3.ptxt: Check that the positioning pin of the front coil spring insulator lower LH is securely inserted.

s2.ptxt: Install SST to the coil spring so that the distance between the upper and lower hooks of SST is at its widest.

atten3.ptxt: Check that the hook claws are securely engaged.

atten4.ptxt: The front coil spring LH can also be compressed using a hydraulic coil spring compressor.

s2.ptxt: Using SST, compress the front coil spring LH.

atten3.ptxt: Do not use an impact wrench.

s2.ptxt: Install the front coil spring LH.

item.ptxt: Install the front coil spring LH with its end aligned with the step of the front coil spring insulator lower LH.
Install it with the side with the identification mark facing downward.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Coil Spring Insulator Upper LH
Install Front Coil Spring Seat Upper LH
Install Front Suspension Support Dust Seal LH

s2.ptxt: Install a new front suspension support dust seal LH.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Suspension Support Sub-assembly LH
Temporarily Tighten Front Support to Front Shock Absorber Nut

s2.ptxt: Temporarily tighten a new front suspension support to front shock absorber nut LH to the front shock absorber assembly LH.
Release SST and remove SST from the coil spring.

atten3.ptxt: Do not use an impact wrench when removing SST.
